card.fires_on: Small words at set points in standard label warnings, such as "their" in "Patients, their caregivers", "call" after "seek medical attention or", and the "1" in "Clinical Studies (14.x)" references.

modes.label: Clinical Studies section number

card.plain: It fires on small words in stock warning sentences and section cross-references in drug labels.
